7. What this adds over the strongest applicable approaches

The comparisons materially constrain the claim.

Existing machinery	What it already supplies	Established addition here
Astra N1201	A positive Gaussian finite-time instrument and correct outcome-weighted simulation	Necessity derived from all separable decompositions, completing the classification for the stated general correlated-noise model
Dephasing partial-transpose criteria	Powerful entangling conditions and negativity diagnostics	An explicit purely dissipative all-PPT entangling example, plus the complete full-separability boundary
Covariance and local-uncertainty SDPs	Strong witnesses, including detection beyond partial transpose	A proof that a particular covariance condition is complete for this dynamical class
Readout averaging and mitigation	Symmetrization and calibrated correction of readout effects	A null-preserving use of private controls that requires no detector inversion
Measurement-device-independent witnesses	Certification with trusted quantum inputs under their device contracts	A different contract using trusted local controls and an unknown joint POVM; no general dominance claim
Exact noisy-Ising correlator methods	Efficient evaluation of many observables in this model family	Structural classification and operational certification, without a claimed simulation speedup

The covariance comparison is especially important: the strongest matched covariance SDP, given the same acquired moments, can produce the same kind of witness. I have not established a better estimator. Covariance criteria were already developed as powerful separability tests, and exact noisy-Ising correlation methods already avoid full density-matrix simulation for many observables. 
arxiv.org
+1

Measurement-device-independent witnesses also provide a strong alternative, but with trusted quantum-input and device-separation assumptions different from this protocol. Neither construction subsumes the other under identical resources. 
arxiv.org

I accounted for the two Lindbladian-learning papers you supplied. The unknown-SPAM work uses trusted local control and visibility conditions to learn gauge-invariant components; the arbitrary-Lindbladian work specifies preparation and measurement access. Neither was treated as establishing the unknown-backaction interface. The present learner asks a narrower physical question a
